# OMGChinese

> > Comprehensive Chinese language learning platform featuring bilingual dictionaries, Pinyin conversion tools, and name transliteration services.

OMGChinese provides essential tools for learning Mandarin Chinese, including dictionary lookups with stroke order diagrams, automated Hanzi-to-Pinyin conversion with tone marks, and practical utilities for transliterating English names into Chinese characters. The platform serves both beginners and advanced learners with resources covering vocabulary, pronunciation, idioms, and example sentences.

## Key Topics

- Pinyin
- Hanzi
- Chinese-English Dictionary
- Language Learning
- Translation Tools
- Pinyin Converter
- Tone Marks
- Chinese Idioms
- Example Sentences
- Pronunciation
- Name Transliteration
- Stroke Order
- Text Conversion
- Hanzi Lookup

## Dictionary & Reference

- [Chinese-English Dictionary - 英汉词典 - 汉英词典](https://www.omgchinese.com/dictionary/): Bilingual dictionary with Pinyin, Hanzi, examples, idioms & stroke order

## Language Tools

- [Chinese to Pinyin Converter Online](https://www.omgchinese.com/tools/chinese-to-pinyin-converter): Convert Hanzi to Pinyin with tone marks and text segmentation
- [Write Your Name in Chinese](https://www.omgchinese.com/tools/write-english-name-in-chinese): Transliterate English names into Chinese characters
